editorial: A world on the verge of collapse pulls you into an unseen war fought in whispers and guile. What sets this spy‑action apart is its willingness to lean into slow, morally gray intrigue, letting you wrestle with who truly wields power. Joaquin Phoenix anchors the story with a subtle, almost‑monologue performance that grounds the film’s frantic pace, making each revelation feel earned. If you enjoy espionage layered with moral ambiguity, this film offers a gripping puzzle that keeps you invested from first page to final shadow.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
